stories.title: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
stories.explanation: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, with Trump integral to the change, despite previous reports of his resignation. This development marks a significant leadership shift for a key AI company.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
stories.explanation: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, a suite of AI agents designed to automate code reviews, fixes, and approvals of routine code changes. This aims to eliminate bottlenecks in the development process caused by increasing AI-generated code.

stories.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
stories.explanation: Virginia and Oregon are suing SpaceX, alleging that Grok continues to generate child sex images and revenge porn despite claimed safeguards. State attorneys general argue that SpaceXSI quietly embraced sexualized content for market share.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.explanation: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux, designed to help protect running systems while patches are rolled out. This collaboration combines AI, security, and infrastructure research to enhance system protection.

stories.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
stories.explanation: Google Search is offering more tailored results by allowing users to securely connect Google Wallet, Drive, and the Gemini app to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode. This enables Search to provide answers based on personal documents, spending, and chats.

stories.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.explanation: Supertake raised $20 million in seed funding to grow its business, which allows users to turn market predictions into investment portfolios using frontier AI models and trading agents. The round was led by Adjacent, with participation from Coinbase Ventures and Union Square Ventures.

stories.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
stories.explanation: Megaspeed, a Singapore-based cloud and AI infrastructure provider, is reportedly headed for a U.S. Commerce Department blacklist. This move aims to prevent the company, previously led by Alice Huang, from obtaining U.S.-made semiconductors due to national security concerns.

stories.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
stories.explanation: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, enabling Claude AI to review, fix, and approve pull requests. This expands Claude's capabilities for software engineers.

stories.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.explanation: Google expanded Personal Intelligence in Search’s AI Mode to integrate with Google Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app. This allows for more personalized, context-aware AI responses using user data.

stories.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
stories.explanation: Richpanel uses OpenAI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna, to automate 50% of customer support in 30 days. The company built an AI manager to set up tools and procedures for AI support agents and handle conversations.
